fields.label: Geojson
fields.description: GeoJSON describing a polygon within which to seed drifters. To use this parameter, also have `seed_flag=="geojson"`.

fields.label: Start Time
fields.description: Start time for drifter simulation.

fields.label: Start Time End
fields.description: If used, this creates a range of start times for drifters, starting with `start_time` and ending with `start_time_end`. Drifters will be initialized linearly between the two start times.

fields.label: End Time
fields.description: The end of the simulation. steps, end_time, or duration must be input by user.

fields.label: M3 Per Hour
fields.description: The amount (volume) of oil released per hour (or total amount if release is instantaneous)

fields.label: Oil Film Thickness
fields.description: Seeding value of oil_film_thickness

fields.label: Droplet Diameter Mu
fields.description: The mean diameter of oil droplet for a subsea release, used in normal/lognormal distributions.

fields.label: Droplet Diameter Sigma
fields.description: The standard deviation in diameter of oil droplet for a subsea release, used in normal/lognormal distributions.

fields.label: Droplet Diameter Min Subsea
fields.description: The minimum diameter of oil droplet for a subsea release, used in unifrom distribution.

fields.label: Droplet Diameter Max Subsea
fields.description: The maximum diameter of oil droplet for a subsea release, used in uniform distribution.

fields.label: Emulsification
fields.description: Surface oil is emulsified, i.e. water droplets are mixed into oil due to wave mixing, with resulting increas of viscosity.

fields.label: Dispersion
fields.description: Oil is removed from simulation (dispersed), if entrained as very small droplets.

fields.label: Evaporation
fields.description: Surface oil is evaporated.

fields.label: Update Oilfilm Thickness
fields.description: Oil film thickness is calculated at each time step. The alternative is that oil film thickness is kept constant with value provided at seeding.

fields.label: Biodegradation
fields.description: Oil mass is biodegraded (eaten by bacteria).

fields.label: Run Forward
fields.description: Run forward in time.

fields.label: Time Step
fields.description: Interval between particles updates, in seconds.

fields.label: Time Step Output
fields.description: Time step at which element properties are stored and eventually written to file. Must be a multiple of time_step.

fields.label: Steps
fields.description: Maximum number of steps. End of simulation will be start_time + steps * time_step.

fields.label: Duration
fields.description: The length of the simulation. steps, end_time, or duration must be input by user.

fields.label: Duration Str
fields.description: Duration should be input as a string of ISO 8601. The length of the simulation. steps, end_time, or duration must be input by user.

fields.label: Do3D
fields.description: Set to True to run drifters in 3D, by default False for most drift models.

fields.label: Horizontal Diffusivity
fields.description: Horizontal diffusivity for the simulation.

fields.label: Use Static Masks
fields.description: Set to True to use static masks for known models instead of wetdry masks.

fields.label: Use Auto Landmask
fields.description: A built-in GSHHG global landmask is used if True, otherwise landmask is taken from reader or fallback value.

fields.label: Number of elements
fields.description: The number of elements for the simulation.

fields.label: Radius
fields.description: Radius around each lon-lat pair, within which particles will be randomly seeded.

fields.label: Maximum speed
fields.description: Typical maximum speed of elements, used to estimate reader buffer size

fields.label: Current Uncertainty
fields.description: Add gaussian perturbation with this standard deviation to current components at each time step

fields.label: Stokes Drift
fields.description: Advection elements with Stokes drift (wave orbital motion).

fields.label: Wind Drift Depth
fields.description: The direct wind drift (windage) is linearly decreasing from the surface value (wind_drift_factor) until 0 at this depth.

fields.label: Wind Drift Factor
fields.description: Elements at surface are moved with this fraction of the wind vector, in addition to currents and Stokes drift

fields.label: Wind Uncertainty
fields.description: Add gaussian perturbation with this standard deviation to wind components at each time step.

fields.label: Depth of release
fields.description: Depth below sea level where elements are released. This depth is neglected if seafloor seeding is set selected.

fields.label: Seed Seafloor
fields.description: Elements are seeded at seafloor, and seeding depth (z) is neglected.

fields.label: Mixed Layer Depth
fields.description: Fallback value for ocean_mixed_layer_thickness if not available from any reader

fields.label: Vertical Mixing Timestep
fields.description: Time step used for inner loop of vertical mixing.

fields.label: Vertical Mixing
fields.description: Activate vertical mixing scheme with inner loop
